name: How does outdoor lighting enhance security for my property?
description: Outdoor lighting deters intruders by eliminating dark spots, illuminating entry points, and using motion sensors to alert occupants to activity.

mainEntity.name: How does outdoor lighting enhance security for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdoor lighting significantly enhances property security by eliminating dark areas where intruders might hide. Well-placed lights along pathways, around entry points, and in landscape features create a brightly lit perimeter, making your home a less attractive target. Motion-activated lights can surprise and deter trespassers while alerting occupants to activity. Consistent, even illumination around your property improves visibility for security cameras and for anyone observing your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor lighting deters intruders by eliminating dark spots, illuminating entry points, and using motion sensors to alert occupants to activity.
